requirement: Live-wave section 19 and canonical-shape section 16 dashboard behavior

findings.evidence: The research result projection includes frontier, funnel, accounting totals, coverage, completeness and candidates, but omits observed_sample.origins_observed. Frontier.status also does not return per-origin counts.
findings.required_action: Show explicitly scoped captured origins and provide frontier origin counts if presenting pending-domain coverage. Do not describe observed origins as independent publishers.

findings.source: apps/web/src/app.ts::render Research and Provider calls branches
findings.evidence: The Provider calls table shows individual cache_hit flags. The per-run research view does not show an aggregate hit ratio or its denominator.
findings.required_action: Expose a per-run cache-hit metric with numerator, denominator and empty-run unknown handling. Identify whether the denominator includes failed logical acquisitions; separate fixture, cached and live provenance.

findings.evidence: Each donor row uses the literal NOT_STARTED for Absorption even though research/commerce/donor-lifecycle-review.json records evidence-backed canonical states. Overview reports only aggregate absorbed/oracle/extinct counts.
findings.required_action: Use the canonical lifecycle projection for each donor and retain its evidence scope. Preserve full-absorption and extinction counts without promoting bounded proofs to whole-donor claims.

findings.evidence: Several labels contain encoding-corrupted separators and apostrophes. TypeScript compilation does not establish that displayed labels are readable. Browser tooling failed initialization previously, so rendering remains unverified.
findings.required_action: Repair the literals using explicit UTF-8 handling, build the dashboard, and verify the displayed research/detail/accounting surfaces. Record visual verification limitations if browser tooling remains unavailable.

verified_supplier_scope.finding: Visible public language maps supplier, manufacturer, distributor and customization claims with source locators. Explicit structured organization offers map published offer, eligible order quantity, unit price, currency, lead time, origin, shipping details and certification claims. Unobserved or unverified commercial facts remain UNKNOWN.
verified_supplier_scope.limits: This source check does not prove all input formats, negotiated quotations or independently verified supplier relationships. The separate live supplier proof establishes the first legitimate public route.
